Lbl NEW

ClDrw
AxesOff
GridOff
FnOff
RcPic MINEPIC1

Lbl MAIN
ClLCD
DispG
Menu(1,"Play",PLAY,2,"Custm",CUSTM,3,"Data",DATA,4,"Reset",RESET,5,"Exit",EXIT)

Lbl DATA
For(A,1,6
MINEDATA((A-1)*4+1)→B
MINEDATA((A+5)*4+1)→C
Outpt(A,1,A
Outpt(A,2,".  [ ]"
If B==1
Outpt(A,6,"*"
Outpt(A,12,A+6
If A+6<10
Outpt(A,13,".  [ ]"
If A+6>9
Outpt(A,14,". [ ]"
If C==1
Outpt(A,17,"*"
End
Pause
Goto MAIN

Lbl RESET
Disp "Are you sure you want","to Reset all Data?"
Menu(1,"Yes",YES,5,"No",MAIN)

Lbl YES
{0,8,6,4,0,8,8,6,0,10,8,10,0,10,10,11,0,9,9,10,0,12,10,16,0,10,10,14,0,12,10,18,0,11,10,18,0,12,10,21,0,12,10,24,0,12,10,30}→MINEDATA
Goto MAIN

Lbl PLAY
Input "Level(1-12): ",L
If L<1 or L>12
Goto PLAY
(L-1)*4→B
MINEDATA(B+1)→C
MINEDATA(B+2)→N
MINEDATA(B+3)→M
MINEDATA(B+4)→Z
Disp "Length:","Width:","Mines:","Percent:   %","Complete:","Level Loading..."
Outpt(2,9,N
Outpt(3,8,M
Outpt(4,8,Z
Outpt(5,10,100*round(Z/(M*N),2)
If C==0
Outpt(6,11,"NO"
If C==1
Outpt(6,11,"YES"
Goto START

Lbl CUSTM
0→L
Input "Lenghth: ",N
Input "Width: ",M
Input "Mines: ",Z
If N>12 or N<1 or M>10 or M<1 or Z≥M*N
Goto CUSTM

Lbl START
{M+2,N+2}→dim MINE1
{M+2,N+2}→dim MINE2
Fill(0,MINE1)
Fill(0,MINE2)

0→H
Repeat H==Z
randInt(2,M+1)→A
randInt(2,N+1)→B
If MINE1(A,B)>8
End
9→MINE1(A,B)
1→MINE2(A,B)
MINE1(A-1,B-1)+1→MINE1(A-1,B-1)
MINE1(A,B-1)+1→MINE1(A,B-1)
MINE1(A+1,B-1)+1→MINE1(A+1,B-1)
MINE1(A-1,B)+1→MINE1(A-1,B)
MINE1(A+1,B)+1→MINE1(A+1,B)
MINE1(A-1,B+1)+1→MINE1(A-1,B+1)
MINE1(A,B+1)+1→MINE1(A,B+1)
MINE1(A+1,B+1)+1→MINE1(A+1,B+1)
H+1→H
End

ClLCD
ClDrw
For(A,1,M*6,6
For(B,1,N*6,6
Text(A,B,"[]"
PxOn(A+1,B+2
PxOn(A+5,B+2
End
End
RcPic MINEPIC2
If L<10
Text(19,113,L
If L>9
Text(19,109,L
If L==0
Text(19,103,"Custm"
If Z<10
Text(32,119,Z
If Z>9
Text(32,115,Z
If N<10
Text(53,91,N
If N>9
Text(53,87,N
If M<10
Text(53,111,M
If M>9
Text(53,107,M
1→A
0→B
2→C
2→D
0→F
0→G
PxOn(A,B
PxOn(A+6,B
PxOn(A,B+6
PxOn(A+6,B+6

While 1
Repeat K
getKy→K
End
If K==26
Goto RIGHT
If K==24
Goto LEFT
If K==34
Goto DOWN
If K==25
Goto UP
Goto CONT
End

Lbl RIGHT
If D<N+1:Then
PxOff(A,B
PxOff(A+6,B
B+6→B
D+1→D
PxOn(A,B+6
PxOn(A+6,B+6
End
End

Lbl LEFT
If D>2:Then
PxOff(A,B+6
PxOff(A+6,B+6
B-6→B
D-1→D
PxOn(A,B
PxOn(A+6,B
End
End

Lbl DOWN
If C<M+1:Then
PxOff(A,B
PxOff(A,B+6
A+6→A
C+1→C
PxOn(A+6,B
PxOn(A+6,B+6
End
End

Lbl UP
If C>2:Then
PxOff(A+6,B
PxOff(A+6,B+6
A-6→A
C-1→C
PxOn(A,B
PxOn(A,B+6
End
End

Lbl CONT
If K==21 and MINE2(C,D)<2:Then
MINE1(C,D)→H
Text(A,B+1,"     "
If H>8
Goto LOSE
Text(A,B+2,H
End

If K==31:Then
MINE2(C,D)→H
Text(A,B+1,"     "
If H==0:Then
Text(A,B+2,"F"
PxOn(A+2,B+3
PxOn(A+2,B+4
PxOn(A+3,B+4
2→MINE2(C,D)
F+1→F
End
If H==1:Then
Text(A,B+2,"F"
PxOn(A+2,B+3
PxOn(A+2,B+4
PxOn(A+3,B+4
3→MINE2(C,D)
G+1→G
End
If H==2:Then
Text(A,B+1,"[]"
PxOn(A+1,B+3
PxOn(A+5,B+3
PxOn(A,B+6
0→MINE2(C,D)
F-1→F
End
If H==3:Then
Text(A,B+1,"[]"
PxOn(A+1,B+3
PxOn(A+5,B+3
PxOn(A,B+6
1→MINE2(C,D)
G-1→G
End
If F+G<10:Then
Text(32,103,"0"
Text(32,107,F+G
End
If F+G>9
Text(32,103,F+G
If G==Z and F==0
Goto WIN
End
If K==22
Goto EXIT
If K==23
Pause
End


Lbl WIN
ClDrw
RcPic MINEPIC3
If L>0
1→MINEDATA((L-1)*4+1)
Pause
Goto NEW

Lbl LOSE
ClDrw
RcPic MINEPIC4
Pause
Goto NEW

Lbl EXIT
ClDrw
DelVar(MINE1
DelVar(MINE2
ClLCD
